metadata.objective: With a dedicated non-admin key configured for tpm_limit=64, token_rate_limit_type=total, and an rpm_limit of at least 2, verify a short request succeeds and a subsequent request whose prompt is well over 64 words is rejected with HTTP 429. Requires a clean TPM bucket and a model whose tokenizer counts the longer prompt above the limit. Tokenization and threshold enforcement are provider/model-dependent; the case does not assert exact token accounting. The accepted request can incur provider cost.
